sections.text: Understanding Individual Therapy

I offer individual therapy in a safe, confidential space where you can openly explore your thoughts, emotions, and life challenges without judgment. Whether you are dealing with stress, anxiety, depression, relationship issues, or major life transitions, my goal is to help you gain clarity and a deeper understanding of yourself.

In our one-on-one sessions, I work with you to identify patterns, process emotions, and develop healthier ways of thinking and coping. Together, we focus on building self-awareness, strengthening resilience, and creating meaningful, lasting change.
How I help you heal and grow
My approach is personalized because every individual’s journey is unique. I take the time to understand your needs and create a therapy plan tailored specifically to you.
Start Your Journey Towards Better Mental Health
Choosing therapy is a powerful step toward a healthier and more balanced life. If you are feeling overwhelmed or seeking clarity, this may be the right time to begin.

I provide a supportive, non-judgmental environment where you can move forward at your own pace. My role is to guide and support you through each step of the process with care, understanding, and intention.
Taking the first step can feel difficult, but it is also an investment in your well-being, growth, and future.
Ready To Begin Your Journey ?
Get in touch today to schedule your free 15-minute phone consultation and take the first step toward clarity, growth, and meaningful change.
Helping Teens Navigate Life with Confidence

The teenage years can feel overwhelming, from academic pressure to social challenges and emotional ups and downs. I provide therapy sessions in a safe and supportive space where teens can express themselves openly, feel heard, and receive the support they need to grow stronger.
Common Challenges
Early guidance can make a lifelong difference. I help teens build a strong emotional foundation today.
Academic stress and performance pressure
Anxiety, overthinking, and mood swings
Low self-esteem and identity confusion
Peer pressure and social anxiety
Family conflicts and communication gaps
Screen time, behavior, and emotional regulation
My Approach
A Supportive & Relatable Approach
I connect with teens in a way that feels natural and comfortable. I use interactive and age-appropriate methods to help them open up and feel understood.
I focus on building trust first, because real progress begins when teens feel safe to be themselves.
Ready To Begin Your Journey ?
Get in touch today to schedule your free 15-minute phone consultation and take the first step toward clarity, growth, and meaningful change.
Struggling with Focus, Organization, or Follow Through?
ADHD is not just about attention, it affects planning, time management, and daily functioning. Whether you are a student, teen, or adult, these challenges can impact your confidence and productivity.
I offer ADHD therapy and executive functioning coaching to help you build practical systems to stay organized, focused, and in control.
Signs You Might Need Support
Do You Often Experience…?
Therapy vs Coaching – What’s the Difference?
ADHD Therapy
I focus on emotional regulation, self awareness, and managing stress, anxiety, or frustration linked to ADHD.
Executive Function Coaching
I focus on practical skills like planning, organizing, prioritizing, and building routines that actually work in real life.
My Approach
How I Help You Succeed
Understand your unique challenges
Identify patterns and triggers
Build personalized systems & routines
Practice real-life strategies
Track progress and adjust as you grow
Ready To Begin Your Journey ?
Get in touch today to schedule your free 15-minute phone consultation and take the first step toward clarity, growth, and meaningful change.
Anxiety & Stress

Anxiety may show up as worry, perfectionism, restlessness, or difficulty relaxing. I work with you to identify patterns, strengthen coping strategies, and support your nervous system in finding greater balance.

Anxiety and stress can appear in many forms, including overthinking, irritability, or feeling constantly overwhelmed. These experiences often affect sleep, focus, relationships, and overall well-being, and therapy provides a space to understand their root causes and how they impact daily life.
Common Signs of Anxiety & Stress
Stress is a normal part of life, but ongoing anxiety can begin to affect your daily functioning. You might notice:
How Therapy Can Help

I provide a supportive and non-judgmental space where you can explore what may be contributing to your anxiety or stress. Together, we work to identify triggers, understand thought patterns, and develop healthier ways of responding to challenging situations. The process is collaborative and focused on helping you regain a sense of control and clarity.
Ready To Begin Your Journey ?
Get in touch today to schedule your free 15-minute phone consultation and take the first step toward clarity, growth, and meaningful change.
Trauma Informed Therapy
“Sometimes, it is not about what happened, but how it stays with you.”
You may find yourself reacting strongly, feeling overwhelmed, or struggling to feel safe even when everything seems fine. This is often how trauma shows up.
I offer trauma-informed therapy to help you understand these experiences with compassion, not judgment.
Creating a Foundation of Safety
Trauma-informed therapy begins by creating a sense of emotional and mental safety. I focus on building trust so you can express yourself openly, without fear or pressure.
A Judgment-Free Environment
You are not rushed or forced to share anything before you are ready. I guide each session with respect, empathy, and understanding.
Understanding Your Experience
Trauma can affect how you respond to everyday situations. I gently help you explore your experiences and recognize patterns without feeling overwhelmed.
Building Resilience at Your Own Pace
Healing is not about rushing; it is about steady and meaningful progress. I guide you in developing tools that help you feel calmer, stronger, and more balanced.
The Healing Journey
What Healing Can Look Like
It does not start with fixing everything. It starts with feeling safe.
Then slowly, you begin to understand your patterns. I guide you in learning ways to calm your mind and body. We process your experiences at a pace that feels right for you.
Over time, things begin to feel lighter, clearer, and more manageable.
Ready To Begin Your Journey ?
Get in touch today to schedule your free 15-minute phone consultation and take the first step toward clarity, growth, and meaningful change.

Sleep and Insomnia Support for Restful Nights

Struggling with sleepless nights or poor sleep quality? I offer personalized support to help you understand the root causes of insomnia and guide you with proven techniques to achieve deep, restful, and consistent sleep naturally and effectively.
Creating a Foundation of Restful Sleep
Sleep support begins by helping you feel calm, safe, and at ease both mentally and physically. I focus on creating a sense of comfort so you can relax without pressure or restlessness.
A Comfortable and Supportive Space

You are given the time and space to understand your sleep challenges without pressure. I do not rush the process or expect everything to be fixed at once, and you can move at a pace that feels right for you.
Understanding My Sleep Patterns

Sleep challenges can affect how you feel and function throughout the day. I gently help you explore your sleep patterns, habits, and triggers so you can understand what may be impacting your rest without feeling overwhelmed.
Building Better Sleep at My Own Pace
Improving sleep is not about rushing; it is about steady and meaningful progress. I help you develop practical tools that support calmer, more relaxed, and better-balanced nights.
Ready To Begin Your Journey ?
Get in touch today to schedule your free 15-minute phone consultation and take the first step toward clarity, growth, and meaningful change.
Strengthening Relationships, One Conversation at a Time

Healthy relationships are the foundation of emotional well-being. Whether you are facing communication challenges, recurring conflicts, or emotional distance, I help you reconnect, understand each other, and grow together.
Common Relationship Challenges I Address
I create a safe and supportive space where you can explore your relationships with honesty and clarity. I focus on building trust so you can express yourself openly without fear or pressure.
Communication Breakdown
I help you express your thoughts clearly and listen with empathy to reduce misunderstandings.
Conflict Resolution
I help you develop healthier ways to handle disagreements without causing hurt or distance.
Trust & Emotional Distance
I help you rebuild trust and reconnect emotionally in a safe and supportive environment.
Family & Social Dynamics
I help you improve your relationships with family members, friends, and colleagues.
My Approach
I believe every relationship is unique. I use evidence-based techniques to help you understand patterns, improve communication, and build stronger emotional connections.
Ready To Begin Your Journey ?
Get in touch today to schedule your free 15-minute phone consultation and take the first step toward clarity, growth, and meaningful change.
What is Mindfulness Based Therapy?

Mindfulness-based therapy helps you become fully present in the moment without judgment. I combine traditional therapeutic techniques with mindfulness practices such as breathing exercises, body awareness, and meditation.
This approach helps you observe your thoughts and emotions rather than becoming overwhelmed by them. Instead of reacting automatically, I help you respond with greater clarity and calmness.
Understanding Mindfulness-Based Therapy
Mindfulness-based therapy helps you stay grounded in the present moment while calmly observing your thoughts and emotions. It helps reduce mental clutter and build emotional awareness.
Present Moment Awareness
I help you focus on the present moment instead of worrying about the past or future, creating a greater sense of calm and control.
Non Judgmental Thinking
I help you develop the ability to observe your thoughts without labeling them as good or bad.
Improved Sleep Quality
I help you understand your emotions more clearly instead of reacting impulsively to them.
Mind Body Connection
I help you become more aware of how your thoughts affect your physical and emotional state.
How It Helps You

Mindfulness-based therapy is highly effective in helping you manage stress, anxiety, depression, and emotional challenges. It helps you break the cycle of negative thinking and develop a healthier relationship with your mind.
By practicing mindfulness regularly, you gain better control over your emotions and improve your overall mental well-being.
Ready To Begin Your Journey ?

Burnout & Life Transitions
Burnout and Life Transitions Support
Finding Balance, Clarity and a Fresh Start

Feeling overwhelmed, stuck, or emotionally drained? Whether you are facing burnout from work or navigating a major life change, you do not have to go through it alone. I support you in regaining a sense of control, rebuilding your energy, and moving forward with confidence.
Understanding Burnout & Life Transitions
Burnout and life transitions can build up quietly over time until everything starts to feel exhausting and unclear. Recognizing these patterns is the first step toward healing and meaningful growth.
Emotional Exhaustion
You may feel constantly tired, low on energy, and find even small tasks overwhelming.
Major Life Changes
You may be going through career shifts, breakups, relocation, or personal loss that disrupt your sense of stability.
Loss of Motivation
You may struggle to stay productive or feel disconnected from your goals and passions.
Mental Overload
You may experience too many thoughts, decisions, and pressures, leading to stress and confusion.
Rebuild Your Energy & Direction

Burnout and life transitions can leave you feeling stuck, drained, and uncertain about what comes next. This phase can also become an opportunity to pause, reflect, and realign your life with what truly matters.
With the right support and guidance, I help you regain clarity, restore your energy, and move forward with confidence toward a more balanced and fulfilling life.
Ready To Begin Your Journey ?
Get in touch today to schedule your free 15-minute phone consultation and take the first step toward clarity, growth, and meaningful change.
Understanding Self-Esteem Difficulties

Self-esteem difficulties involve persistent negative beliefs about yourself. These can affect how you think, feel, and behave in everyday situations, often leading to self-doubt, fear of failure, or avoidance of opportunities
You may experience constant self-criticism and a lack of confidence.
Common Signs of Low Self-Esteem
Low self-esteem can develop over time, often shaping how you see yourself and your abilities. Recognizing these patterns is the first step toward building confidence and self-worth.
Constant Self-Doubt
Questioning your abilities even when you are capable
Overthinking Mistakes
Focusing too much on small errors or failures
Avoiding Challenges
Fear of failure stops you from trying new things
Comparing Yourself to Others
Feeling inferior or “less than” others
My Approach to Building Self-Esteem

My approach focuses on helping you build a strong and lasting sense of self-worth through guided support and practical techniques. I work collaboratively with you to understand your experiences, challenge negative thought patterns, and develop healthier ways of thinking and behaving. By creating a safe and supportive environment, I help you recognize your strengths, improve confidence, and cultivate a more positive relationship with yourself over time.
Ready To Begin Your Journey ?
Understanding Anger & Emotional Control

Anger management is not about suppressing your feelings, it is about learning how to express them in a healthy and constructive way. It involves recognizing early signs of anger, identifying triggers, and applying techniques to stay calm and in control.
When Anger Starts Affecting Your Life
Recognizing the early warning signs can help you take control before anger begins to impact your relationships, health, and daily life.
Frequent Outbursts
You find yourself losing control over small issues.
Relationship Conflicts
Arguments and misunderstandings become more common.
Physical Reactions
Increased heart rate, muscle tension, or aggressive behavior.
Calming Down
It takes a long time to cool off after getting angry.
My Approach to Anger Management

My approach focuses on helping you understand the root causes of your anger while equipping you with practical tools to manage it effectively. I combine proven therapeutic techniques with personalized guidance to help you respond calmly, think clearly, and build healthier emotional habits.
Ready To Begin Your Journey ?
Get in touch today to schedule your free 15-minute phone consultation and take the first step toward clarity, growth, and meaningful change.
Supporting You in Raising Happy, Resilient Children

Parenting is rewarding, but it can also feel overwhelming at times. I provide parent support services that offer guidance, tools, and emotional support to help you navigate challenges with confidence and care.

Parent support focuses on helping caregivers better understand their child’s emotional, behavioral, and developmental needs. Whether you are facing daily struggles or specific concerns, I work with you to build practical strategies and stronger connections at home.
When Parenting Feels Challenging
Every parent faces difficulties, and recognizing them is the first step toward positive change.
Behavioral Issues
Managing tantrums, defiance, or aggression.
Communication Gaps
Difficulty connecting with or being understood by your child.
Emotional Outbursts
Helping children regulate strong emotions.
Academic Pressure
Supporting your child through school-related stress.
Guiding You Every Step of the Way

My approach is centered around understanding your child’s unique needs while empowering you as a parent. I provide practical tools, emotional support, and personalized strategies to create a nurturing and balanced home environment.
Ready To Begin Your Journey ?
Get in touch today to schedule your free 15-minute phone consultation and take the first step toward clarity, growth, and meaningful change.
